title: Use a named key
summary: Julia: Use a named key. Read pages. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: Dict connects keys with values. The => pair operator joins a key and value.
learningObjectives: Use a named key with Julia

blocks.text: Install Julia. Save each example as lesson.jl and run julia lesson.jl, or paste it into the Julia REPL.
The string title is a dictionary key whose value is Moon Trip.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Missing bracket keys throw an error; get can supply a fallback.
